results.title: Štúr
results.overview: Adéla falls in love with Ľudovít Štúr, a scholar, philosopher, and poet who rebels against the societal conditions in Hungary. A revolution breaks out, and Štúr finds himself caught up in events that will forever change Europe and their fate.

results.title: He Brings the News
results.overview: An isolated couple with too much time on their hands develops an unhealthy fascination with their mailman. Violence and absurdity follow as they descend into a world of phantasmagoric delusion.

results.title: WHEEE
results.overview: Little Anna dreams of growing up and becoming part of the adult world. But when her mother and father begin to argue, she doesn’t just grow up magically fast—she even ages prematurely…

results.title: The Imaginaries
results.overview: A journey through the fragility of the mind and encounters with the unknown. Beyond the mind, there are other worlds.

results.title: The Voices of Our Mother
results.overview: When a family matriarch falls seriously ill, relatives gather and discover their shared ancestral ties bind them in unexpected ways.

results.title: Diaspora Power
results.overview: Inspired by the stories of Haitian women and men who arrived in Quebec during the 1960s and 1970s, Diaspora Power, directed by Joseph Hillel, traces a generation navigating exile, migration, and the challenges of building a new home.  Through intimate personal stories, the documentary explores the realities of integration and systemic racism alongside the solidarity, community networks, and cultural connections that sustained Haitian immigrants as they established new lives in Quebec. Together, these individual experiences form a collective portrait of a diaspora determined to maintain its roots while becoming an integral part of Quebec society.  Diaspora Power is both an act of remembrance and transmission, honoring the people whose lives, labor, and resilience helped shape the social and cultural fabric of contemporary Quebec.

results.title: Bershama
results.overview: A young man invents a new cheating method to escape the hell of high school, which leads him into a funny cat and mouse game with a cunning teacher.

results.title: If I Tell You
results.overview: IF I TELL YOU uncovers a family’s pressing secret while the 12-year-old son finds his voice and the courage to stand up for what is right.

results.title: In The Shadow of a High Rise Flat
results.original_title: In The Shadow of a High Rise Flat
results.overview: Deirdre and Jim meet in secret, again. They wander the evening streets of Glasgow pondering life, love and their future but there is a secret being kept that will change their relationship forever.

results.title: Plötzlich Schwester
results.overview: Two sisters who couldn't be more different are unaware of their father's double life with two families and the existence of the other until his sudden death. While stuffy Sandra has no need for such a relationship, chaotic Sandy never leaves her new-found sister's side.

results.title: Cycles of Resilience: A Journey Through Austin's Black History
results.original_title: Cycles of Resilience: A Journey Through Austin's Black History
results.overview: On Black History Bike Ride’s 6th annual Juneteenth Ride, led by Talib Abdullahi, hundreds of cyclists bike together to learn under-told stories of Black history. From the State Capitol to Austin’s only HBCU to iconic venues like Victory Grill, this journey through history explores the transition from plantation sites to freedom communities, highlights the impact of the 1928 City Plan’s “Negro District” in east Austin, and celebrates the contributions of leaders of the Black community like Jacob Fontaine and Barbara Jordan. Through interviews with local Austinites and thought-leaders like Peniel Joseph and Tara Dudley, an inspirational story of resilience and Black excellence unfolds.

results.title: All That She Wants
results.overview: Thirty-something Millennial Emma breaks up with her boyfriend after he says he's not wanting to have a baby. A girls-night-out with her sister leads to a May-December romance with Zoomer grad student Luke, but things get complicated when she discovers that her new flame was the four-year-old she babysat as a teenager.

results.title: Night Flower: Inside AIPAC's Fight for Influence
results.original_title: Night Flower: Inside AIPAC's Fight for Influence
results.overview: Is AIPAC acting as a foreign agent for Israel? Is its influence waning? Did it help drag the US into war with Iran? Zeteo’s new hour-long investigation ‘Night Flower’ seeks to answer these questions.

results.title: Men of Law
results.overview: A retired detective and his cousin launch a rescue operation when the detective's daughter is kidnapped by a trafficking ring, and law enforcement isn't doing their job.

results.title: Spectral Geography
results.overview: The natural landscape of Colombia’s Río Cauca Valley, with its mountains, forests, and rivers, has been reshaped and transformed for colonial hydroelectric production. Uprooted by the pursuit of profit, a community celebrates a fascinating ritual to remember and mourn its territory, contributing its own images and sounds to the film’s visual and audio stream.

results.title: Helena! Cinema!
results.overview: Short documentary film about Helena Ignez, the great actress of independent Brazilian cinema.

results.title: Las grullas
results.overview: Dr. Patricia Torres, a neonatologist, reflects on the experiences that have shaped her career at the hospital. For years, she has cared for premature babies whose lives begin in fragile circumstances. Inspired by a Japanese legend about a thousand paper cranes, she discovered a new way to understand neonatal care and the complex reality faced by families.

results.title: Pauline
results.overview: The story of Pauline Julien, a singing icon and independence activist, across several decades of Québec history.
